544:t_2:86.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「...I never thought we'd meet again in a place like this...」

544:t_2:88.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I am $$コード：ホワイト$$ now... a member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' field team.」

544:t_2:90.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We have business here at $$ヤムスク１１$$ too.」

544:t_2:92.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「It seems they've begun demolishing the facility...」

544:t_2:93.en:
$n
「...Please tell me. Why are you in $$クロノ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$...?」

544:t_2:94.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I joined around April of last year... They recruited me, saying I had potential.」

544:t_2:96.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Yes, I did. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

544:t_2:97.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I never imagined I would end up fighting you, though...」

544:t_2:98.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on the $$翠の地球$$ a lie!?」

544:t_2:99.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I never told you one.」

544:t_2:100.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I am both $$柏葉真紀$$ the nurse and $$クロノ$$'s $$コード：ホワイト$$.」

544:t_2:101.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Unless the Captain gave me orders, I was simply a nurse working in Japan.」

544:t_2:102.en:
$n
「What exactly do you mean by changing the world!? Is it related to the Reformists' talk of watching over humanity's evolution!?」

544:t_2:103.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We don't need to know that. We simply follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

544:t_2:104.en:
$n
「That's crazy! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what they do!?」

544:t_2:107.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain deserves our trust... Isn't that enough?」

544:t_2:109.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good opportunity, $n. I'll forgive you for raising your sword against the Captain.」

544:t_2:110.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will welcome you if you apologize.」

544:t_2:112.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Come on, $n. ...Or won't you do what I'm asking?」

544:t_2:115.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain and I could take you into our embrace.」

544:t_2:118.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Why can't you listen to the Captain...?」

544:t_2:123.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The explosions keep coming... Even $$レナード$$ seems not to have expected this...)

544:t_2:124.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The confusion let me escape... Now if I can get out of here and contact $c...)

544:t_2:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why are you here, $$テッサ$$...?」

544:t_2:129.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I came here with $$相良$$, but we were caught in an explosion and got separated...」

544:t_2:132.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm so glad! I got to see you again, $$カナメ$$!」

544:t_2:134.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$ is nearby too... If I can just see him...)

544:t_2:140.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never expected to end up trapped with you...」

544:t_2:142.en:
$$レナード$$
「You've got me. I never thought anyone besides $$テレサ$$ and me had their eye on this place...」

544:t_2:143.en:
$$レナード$$
「No... Calling them human may be misleading.」

544:t_2:145.en:
$$レナード$$
「Heh heh... What a shame. Since you can't beat me in an AS, this was your best chance to kill me, and you've wasted it.」

544:t_2:146.en:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to have grown vulgar since we last met.」

544:t_2:147.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Let's stop. We agreed to a temporary truce to get out of here.」

544:t_2:148.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you understand that, get to work. If we cannot move this rubble, we could run out of oxygen within hours.」

544:t_2:151.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of answering.」

544:t_2:152.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then how would you feel if I told you $$千鳥かなめ$$ was here?」

544:t_2:154.en:
$$レナード$$
「We were separated when we got caught in the explosion, though.」

544:t_2:156.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're so worried you've stopped working. ...But it's all right. She is alive. Certainly.」

544:t_2:158.en:
$$レナード$$
「She's lucky. Almost impossibly so.」

544:t_2:159.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is no basis for certainty.」

544:t_2:160.en:
$$レナード$$
「She's had so many narrow escapes. I think it's almost strange that she's still alive today.」

544:t_2:161.en:
$$宗介$$
(It is true that $$千鳥$$ has survived situations that even made my blood run cold, but...)

544:t_2:162.en:
$$レナード$$
「Her good luck is abnormal.」

544:t_2:163.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ has always acted without giving up, judging what she can do and following her strong will and convictions.」

544:t_2:164.en:
$$宗介$$
「In that sense, she is just like an ordinary veteran soldier.」

544:t_2:165.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll admit she has outstanding willpower and initiative. But couldn't you look at it this way?」

544:t_2:166.en:
$$レナード$$
「That having those abilities in itself is her good fortune.」

544:t_2:168.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well, perhaps it is. It's circular wordplay.」

544:t_2:169.en:
$$レナード$$
「Besides, it isn't luck that kept her alive. It is inevitability.」
